digest.component_or_area: module-size CI gate (gerrit-verify and test workflows)
propositions: Introduce .github/module-size-limit.txt as single source of truth for the 800 LOC absolute cap, read by both workflows and contract test.
Rewrite the module-size gate in both gerrit-verify.yaml and test.yml to enforce an absolute cap with no allowlist exemptions, failing if any src/rebar/**/*.py file exceeds the limit.

Implement a limit-lock mechanism that fetches main by explicit GitHub URL, compares the base limit to the current limit, and fails with an override-required error if they differ (unless main lacks the file, indicating bootstrap).
Emit a warning (not silent failure) if the explicit main fetch fails, allowing the absolute cap floor to remain as a fallback.
Update contract and parity tests to read the limit from the limit file instead of allowlist/ceilings, removing allowlist sync assertions.
Retain the now-empty allowlist and ceilings files to keep main's current gate green during this change's CI run; Phase 2b will delete them after the new gate is live.
